en: Vintage multi-view postcard with three black‑and‑white photographs and handwritten text in old Bulgarian script. The top left image shows a city garden with lush plants and a tall monument/obelisk commemorating those fallen in the Russo‑Turkish War. The top right image shows a large two‑storey institutional building behind trees, likely a school (gymnasium). The bottom image shows another substantial rectangular school building with people standing in front. Printed captions in Bulgarian are beneath the photos, and the right side is filled with cursive handwritten correspondence. The main printed greeting reads "Поздравь отъ Ст.-Загора." (Greetings from Stara Zagora).
